title: Status lights
intro: The hub has two lights: green shows its own state, red asks for attention. Red flashes in groups — the number of flashes names the problem.
modeHint_full: Green beats slowly while the hub works; red shows every warning.
modeHint_quiet: No green beat in normal work; everything else is shown.
modeHint_off: Dark, except a factory reset, a firmware update, «Find this hub» and «no module answers».
saveFailed: The hub did not take it: {why}
identifyHint: Both lights blink fast for 10 seconds.
identifyOn: Blinking for 10 seconds — look for the hub with both lights flashing.
eventTitle: The red light reports an event
eventText: It keeps flashing until you acknowledge it here, or for 24 hours.
acked: Acknowledged — the red light no longer reports it.
loadFailed: The lights' state could not be read.
G3: setup: the hub's own Wi-Fi is open, no home network yet
R1: no module answers — nothing is measured
R5: Wi-Fi not reachable for over 5 minutes
R6: the MQTT broker is not reachable for over 5 minutes
R8: a firmware update was rolled back
